_about: Rubric scores for the 50 judgement-based prompts of the 75-prompt tuning set, live run 2026-11-18. [score, reason] per configuration. Formatting labels like 'Translation:' are not penalised; added notes, alternatives or commentary are. Romanised Hindi is accepted as Hindi (author's ruling, 2026-11-18: the 'wrong script = 0' rule is overturned).
